title-group.article-title: Effects of thymol on piglet growth

sec.p: Background: Antibiotics are widely used in swine production.
Results show that thymol improved ADG by 15%.
In conclusion, dietary thymol supplementation significantly improved growth performance and gut health in weaned piglets under E. coli challenge.

sec.title: 2.1 Animals and Diets
sec.p: A total of 72 weaned barrows (Duroc x Landrace x Yorkshire, 21 d of age, initial BW 7.5 kg) were randomly allocated.

sec.title: 2.2 Sample Collection
sec.p: At the end of the 28-day experiment, jejunal mucosa and cecal content were collected.

sec.title: 3.1 Growth Performance
sec.p: Dietary thymol significantly increased ADG compared with the challenged control (P < 0.05).

sec.title: Discussion
sec.p: Our findings demonstrate that thymol is a promising alternative to antibiotics...
